explanation: New sourceJson.test.ts covers the transport's family allow-list, version cache-bust, shared requests, forget-on-failure and reset. New baselineTeaser.test.ts checks, over the real reader and public NeuroSeq products, that every teaser row equals the survey's group mean and that AgRP groups are not pooled. Survey loader tests use resetSourceRequests/sourceJson; portal and gene-report fixtures use the BaselineTeaser groups shape.
